parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
6:42 PM

Parso, Sat 14 Nov ko mummy ka birthday hai, to cake kal Fri 13 Nov tak order kar do, taaki time pe mil jaye. Mere hisaab se ye options achhe rahenge:

Rasmalai cake: desi swaad, aur zyada tar mummy log ko pasand aata hai.
Chocolate truffle: sabka favourite, kabhi galat nahi jaata.
Fresh fruit cake: halka aur kam meetha, agar sugar ka dhyan rakhna ho.
Photo cake: mummy ki pasandida photo ke saath, thoda special touch.

Mummy ko kaunsa flavour sabse zyada pasand hai?

6:42 PM

ਮੰਮੀ ਲਈ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਕੇਕ ਵਧੀਆ ਰਹੇਗਾ?
6:42 PM

Mummy ke birthday (Sat 14 Nov) ke liye mera pick hai chocolate truffle, ye kabhi galat nahi jaata. Cake Fri 13 Nov tak order kar dena, taaki time pe mil jaye.

Rasmalai cake: desi swaad, halka meetha.
Fresh fruit cake: kam meetha, sugar ka dhyan ho to best.
Photo cake: unki favourite photo ke saath, thoda special.

Mummy ko chocolate pasand hai ya kuch halka aur desi?

Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
6:42 PM

No, Mon 2 Nov wasn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know, so it was a normal working day. I can't check live holiday lists, so a company or bank-specific leave is possible. This year's Diwali holidays fell later, around Sun 8 Nov and Tue 10 Nov.
